ideas: Who the gift was for and the occasion
How you chose or made it
Their reaction and how you felt

phrases.phrase: put a lot of thought into

model: I'd like to talk about a gift I gave my mum for her fiftieth birthday last year. My mum is a big fan of old Vietnamese music, and when she was young she used to sing at family parties all the time. So I wanted to give her something personal rather than a bag or a piece of jewellery. I really put a lot of thought into it. About two months before the party, I secretly collected old photos and videos from my aunts and uncles, including a very blurry clip of her singing at her own wedding. Then I hired a local studio to turn her favourite song into a new recording, with the photos as a music video. I also printed a small photo book with a message from every family member. It wasn't cheap, but it was a one-off, and nobody else in the world has anything like it. At the party, after dinner, we played the video on the TV. The look on her face was unforgettable. She was over the moon, and halfway through she burst into tears and hugged me for ages. Even my dad, who never shows emotions, looked a bit emotional. She still watches the video on her phone and shows it to all her friends. It was definitely a thoughtful gift, and honestly, it was worth every penny.
